This invoice prints its real vendor only as a stylized logo; the plain text nearest the letterhead is the dispatch service in the top-right contact block, so vendor_name_extract takes that instead. The domain-corroboration tiebreak (field_policy.vendor_domain_tiebreak) now settles it from www.priorityappliance.com / dispatch@priorityappliance.com, giving HAPPY_PATH 12/12 on BOTH the HEAD and current analyzers. The written form still alternates between the normalised generate name ('Priority Appliance', 8/12) and the printed extract name ('PRIORITY appliance service', 4/12) -- both correct, so the form is not asserted while the routing is.
